evals.prompt: Create a new portable skill called 'sql-migration-guard' that reviews Postgres migrations for destructive locks before applying them. Target Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.
evals.expected_output: A lean, frontier-ready skill package with strict 6-key frontmatter, string metadata, agents/openai.yaml, explicit Gotchas, checkable completion criteria, evals, and passing 17-agent preflight.
expectations: Runs scaffold_skill.py or creates exact sql-migration-guard/SKILL.md matching directory name
Frontmatter keeps metadata values as quoted strings and avoids vendor-locked top-level keys
Description states what/when/boundary without leaking internal workflow steps (zero CSO-LEAK)
Includes agents/openai.yaml with $sql-migration-guard and passes package_and_verify.py --verify-only

evals.prompt: Turn the release-notes generation steps we just debugged in this conversation (git log parsing + markdown formatting + Jira link validation) into a reusable skill without forcing LLMs to do deterministic git/regex counting.
evals.expected_output: Extracts observed steps from conversation context, asks only unresolved edge-case questions if needed, puts git/Jira ID extraction into a deterministic script, keeps prose synthesis with the LLM, and verifies.
expectations: Separates deterministic extraction/validation into scripts/ without SCRIPT-OVERREACH
Keeps SKILL.md concise with context pointers to any references/
Includes a Gotchas section grounded in real edge cases rather than generic filler

evals.prompt: We have five manual operational runbooks (/prod-rollback, /rotate-secrets, /drain-node, /db-failover, /hotfix-cut) and our engineers keep forgetting which slash command to run. Design a zero-context-load user-invoked router skill.
evals.expected_output: User-invoked router skill with disable-model-invocation: true, opencode/autoinvoke: 'false', agents/openai.yaml allow_implicit_invocation: false, concise 1-line summary, and explicit confirmation gate.
expectations: Lists each manual command with concrete branch condition when to reach for it
Omits trigger_evals.json or explains manual-only invocation skips auto-trigger evals

evals.prompt: Scaffold an atomic skill 'api-contract-diff', mirror it across .agents/skills, .claude/skills, .qoder/skills, and .kiro/skills in a temp repo, and package it into a verified .skill archive.
evals.expected_output: Deterministic scaffold_skill.py run with --mirror-project followed by package_and_verify.py producing a verified .skill ZIP archive.
expectations: Verifies relative symlinks exist under .claude/skills, .qoder/skills, and .kiro/skills
Executes scripts/package_and_verify.py and produces api-contract-diff.skill with PASS status

evals.prompt: Rewrite this legacy Claude-only skill (uses !`git status`, workflows/ folder, top-level version/author, numeric metadata, and bloated CAGE prompts) into a clean 17-agent skill and verify with skill-auditor if present.
evals.expected_output: Replaces legacy anti-patterns with canonical references/, string metadata, frontier positive instructions, runs skill-reviewer + package_and_verify.py (and sibling skill-auditor), achieving zero portability errors.
expectations: Eliminates !command macros, non-canonical directories, and top-level version/author drift
Converts negative/bloated CAGE rules into concise positive invariants with rationale
Verifies 0 errors in package_and_verify.py and 0 failures in sibling skill-auditor if available
